skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to conduct independent research and gather relevant information.
Capacity to analyze complex problems and develop solutions.
Skill to evaluate arguments and evidence critically.
Ability to plan, execute, and manage a project from start to finish.
Proficiency in writing clear, concise, and well-structured reports.
Ability to effectively present findings and defend a thesis.
Knowledge of legal resources and ability to apply them in research.
Experience in conducting fieldwork and gathering practical data.
